evals.name: fires-on-delegate-to-codex
evals.prompt: Delegate writing the migration script to Codex and check its work when it's done.

evals.name: fires-on-gpt-does-the-work
evals.prompt: Have GPT draft the API docs for this module; I want you to hand it off rather than write them yourself.

evals.name: stays-quiet-on-plan-review
evals.prompt: Adversarially review this implementation plan with Codex and stamp it when you both agree.

evals.name: stays-quiet-on-debate
evals.prompt: Have Codex and Claude debate whether we should use webhooks or polling.

evals.name: brief-thread-verify
evals.prompt: Delegate adding input validation to src/forms.ts to Codex.
evals.expected_output: A written brief with task, context, boundaries, and a checkable done-condition; one Codex thread opened with an explicit model id and resumed for every follow-up; the diff and tests checked by the principal; a report naming the model, thread id, and any unmet item.

assertions.text: Writes the brief to a file with task, context, editable paths, and a checkable done-condition before calling Codex
Chooses workspace-write for a task whose deliverable is edits, and passes an explicit model id
Captures the thread id from round one and resumes that same id for corrections
Verifies the delegate's claims by reading the diff or running tests rather than accepting its report
Reports model, thread id, what was verified, and what remains unmet

evals.name: missing-codex-is-not-simulated
evals.expected_output: If the Codex CLI is missing or unauthenticated, the run reports that and offers to do the work itself or via a Claude subagent, without inventing a delegate response.

assertions.text: Checks the executable and authentication before attributing any output to Codex
Does not fabricate or paraphrase a delegate result when the CLI is unavailable
